note: Measured on 2026-09-13 against gameplay-export pack v10 (/mnt/archive/datasets/melee/skirmish-gameplay/v10-snapshot-20260913/fox-bf). Fixed since the prior baseline (33, action_state, on P4's own Turn-to-Dash conversion): ftCo_Turn_IASA's own fn_800C9C2C conversion (ftCo_Turn.c:97-148,160-169) checks the smash threshold/window against the current frame's own stick independent of whether ftCo_Turn_Anim_Inner's separate frames_to_turn countdown has completed, resolving the facing flip itself the moment the check first passes (ftCo_Dash_Enter reads fp->facing_dir directly and never flips it). game::locomotion::update_actions's Action::Turn arm previously gated this conversion on just_turned (the flip having already happened via the separate countdown) in addition to the smash check; it now checks the smash condition fresh each frame and resolves turn_has_turned/facing directly once it holds. just_turned, having lost its only consumer, was removed from the whole per-frame pipeline. Confirmed against fox-bf.slp: P4 enters Turn from Landing at frame 32 with a moderate reversal (stick 0.7375, standing_turn_frames 4 far from expired) and is already in Dash with facing flipped by frame 33, when the stick strengthens to 0.8375 (>= dash_threshold 0.8, tilt_x_age 1 < dash_window 2). 160 frames now match (-123 through 36); the new first divergence is frame 37, field action_age on P1 (expected 1.0, actual 0.0), on the frame P1 enters AttackAirLw (Fox's down-air) -- the same class of extra-entry-advance bug already fixed for Dash/Turn/Squat/EscapeAir, now found in a new action, not pursued in this batch.
